carmen: Added redirect /tutorials/legacy-routing -> /docs/dynamic-routing/migrate and a short migration tip: "Pre-warm KV or ramp traffic if you use route-level caching." Draft blurb: 

What's new: Dynamic model routing (beta)
- Opt-in per route via adaptive_routing.enabled = true. Automatically prefers cost-efficient variants and falls back to compatible variants.
- Canary: 10% for 24h, then 50% for 48h before wider rollout.
Known issues:
- On some T4 hosts, sequence length 512 can see a transient ~5-12ms latency while KV cache warms. Mitigation: pin variant or disable adaptive_routing for latency-critical routes. Repro: ./tools/bench --seq 512 --target routing-canary (staging).

Quick snippets:
Curl (changelog):
curl -s -X POST https://api.redwood.ai/v1/generate \
  -H "Authorization: Bearer $REDWOOD_KEY" \
  -d '{"model":"rodeo-3","prompt":"Write a haiku","routing":{"adaptive_routing":{"enabled":true}}}'

Python (how-to):
from redwood import Client
with Client() as client:
    resp = client.generate("Summarize this doc", model="rodeo-3", routing={"adaptive_routing": {"enabled": True}})
    print(resp.text)
